name: gap_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps up at open (driven by overnight SGX Nifty futures or global equity moves), institutional desks and index arbitrageurs with pre-positioned buy orders push the index further in the first 30-90 seconds — their TWAP/VWAP execution algorithms are programmed to absorb the gap rather than mean-revert it. A 0.4-0.8% NIFTY opening gap (90-180 spot points) represents genuine overnight information flow, not noise, and the first 3 bars (15 seconds) of continuation confirm that resting sell orders at the opening level are being absorbed rather than reversing the move. We enter as continuation is confirmed and ride the next 10-15 spot points before institutional order flow exhausts.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Measures overnight gap size relative to prior close. No lookback — it's a fixed daily event. Original used >2% (stocks gap wildly); NIFTY is smoother so 0.3-0.8% threshold is appropriate and captures 2-4 instances per week with genuine institutional positioning behind them.

indicators.name: ret_3
indicators.purpose: 3-bar (15-second) momentum for gap continuation confirmation. Original used 1-min candle direction to confirm; at 5-second bars, 3 bars = 15 seconds of confirmed continuation is sufficient to filter gap-and-fade openings where price immediately reverses. Shorter than 1-min because we trade the early burst, not the full minute.

conditions: ret_3 > 0 (price continuing up in first 15 seconds)
buy_ce.confirmation: 3 bars of positive momentum after open confirms gap is not immediately fading

conditions: ret_3 < 0 (price continuing down in first 15 seconds)
buy_pe.confirmation: 3 bars of negative momentum after open confirms gap-down is not fading

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). If the gap continuation stalls and reverses 8 spot points within 30 seconds, the gap absorption thesis is broken — resting supply at open levels is not being absorbed. Gap failures on NIFTY typically show 6-10 spot point reversals in the first 30 seconds.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). A 0.4-0.8% NIFTY gap is 90-180 spot points; the institutional continuation typically extends 10-20 spot points past open in the first 60-90 seconds. 14 spot points (7 option pts) captures ~60% of the lower end of the expected continuation leg at 1:1.75 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: vix_close < 20 (same as original — gap continuation fails in panic regimes where gaps become traps)
filters.time_filter: 09:15-09:35 only (gap window); after 09:35 any continuation signal is noise
filters.volume_filter: none (original rel_volume > 1.3 used stock volume; NIFTY index volume at 5s is too noisy to be meaningful)
filters.trend_filter: none (gap itself provides the directional thesis)
filters.spread_filter: none (limit order execution at close prices)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — structural gap from overnight SGX/global cues; institutional pre-positioning is persistent behavioral pattern

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from the original: (1) UNIVERSE: individual FnO stocks → NIFTY index only. Stock-specific gaps (>2%) depend on earnings, news; NIFTY gaps reflect macro flow, requiring lower threshold (0.4%). BANKNIFTY excluded because BankNifty gaps are more volatile and prone to reversal. (2) HOLD TIME: until EOD → 90 seconds max. Original captured the full-day momentum after a gap; at 5s resolution we capture only the first institutional continuation burst — the first 30-90 seconds when TWAP algos are most active. The EOD hold at the index level would require much wider stops and is a different thesis entirely. (3) CONFIRMATION: 1-min candle direction → 3-bar (15s) ret_3. Equivalent confirmation at 5s resolution — 3 bars proves the gap is not immediately fading without needing a full minute. Volume filter (rel_volume > 1.3) is dropped since NIFTY index volume is not meaningful at 5-second granularity.
weaknesses: Very narrow trading window (09:15-09:35): only 3-4 trades per day possible maximum
Gap threshold sensitivity: too low catches noise, too high misses actionable gaps
On major macro events (budget, RBI), gaps can be 2%+ and immediately reverse on profit booking
VIX filter may exclude the best gap-up days (global rally gaps) which often have elevated VIX
